LETTER AGREEMENT - HOSPITAL SERVICES RATES AND
TERMS
Date: 17th day of February, 2023
This letter agreement sets out how Crestline Health Partners (the Plan) will reimburse St. Aldric Regional
Medical Center (the Provider) for covered services given to the Plan's members. It replaces the parties'
earlier arrangement dated February 17, 2020, under which clean claims were paid within 35 days and acute
inpatient care was paid at $3,775 per day. Those earlier terms no longer apply.
Rates. Starting on 17th day of February, 2023, the Plan will pay a flat per diem of $3,925 for each day of
acute medical/surgical inpatient care, and one hundred thirty (130) percent of the Medicare fee schedule for
general outpatient services. Behavioral health inpatient stays are paid at $3,525 per day, and emergency
department visits at 145 percent of Medicare.

Payment and filing. The Plan will pay each clean claim within twenty (20) days after it receives the claim.
The Provider must send claims no later than one hundred twenty (120) days after the date of service. A
denied claim may be appealed within 150 days.
Credentialing. The Plan will finish credentialing the Provider's clinicians within ninety (90) days of getting a
complete application.
Duration. This letter agreement begins on the 17th day of February, 2023, runs for three years, and ends on
the 16th day of February, 2026. At the end of that period it will roll over from year to year unless one side
gives notice of non-renewal 60 days ahead. Either side may end it early, without cause, by giving one
hundred twenty (120) days written notice.

Law. This letter agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Florida.
Insurance and records. The Provider will carry professional liability cover of $2,000,000 per occurrence and
keep records for 10 years.
Please countersign below to confirm that this reflects our agreement.
